novelty_judgment: No historical-first claim for individual mathematics or behaviors. Strongest defensible novelty is the continuation-specific evidence ladder connecting bearer identity, consequence representation, task mediation, dependence-sensitive consequence interfaces, learned policy use, intervention extrapolation and domain-bounded mechanism certification.
paper_decision: Draft now. Do not publish yet. Add one retrospective real-agent case study if feasible before aiming at a strong main-track/journal venue.
